# jamfplatform_pro_account (List Resource)

Lists Jamf Pro administrator accounts. Supply an optional case-insensitive `name_substring` filter on the username; filtering is applied client-side after the full list is fetched.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Jamf Pro privilege | Scoped name |
|---|---|
| Read Accounts | `read:pro:accounts` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every Jamf Pro administrator account.
list "jamfplatform_pro_account" "all" {
  provider = jamfplatform
}

# List accounts whose username contains "admin" (case-insensitive).
list "jamfplatform_pro_account" "admin_like" {
  provider = jamfplatform

  config {
    filter = {
      name_substring = "admin"
    }
  }
}
```

### Optional

- `filter` (Attributes) Optional case-insensitive `name_substring` filter applied client-side after the full list is fetched. For exact-name lookup, use the singular `by name` data source instead. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
